name: GrainBinStorageMonitor
tagline: Stored-grain inventory, condition monitoring, fumigation and out-loading in one plug-and-play Power Apps control.
description: A complete grain storage module for farms, co-op depots and grain terminals: every bin, silo, bunker, shed and grain bag with its fill, commodity and quality, temperature-cable heat maps, hot-spot and 7-day rise alerts, a 0–100 storage risk score with advice, aeration control, fumigation exposure and withholding, inspection schedule, contract-spec blending and the out-load programme. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: 8 KPI tiles with drill-down and an alert list
Storage risk score 0–100 with reasons and what to do
Temperature-cable heat map, hot spots and 7-day rise
Status workflow with hygiene check, safe-moisture, sealed-storage, exposure and withholding rules
Blend planner with Suggest blend and contract out-load plan (BlendPlanJson)
Record readings, Record out-load, bulk inspection / aeration / hold, undo
Search, 16 quick chips, filters, grouping, CSV export, paging
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
Demo mode with fictional sample data
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field control)
